_execution_protocol.step_1: Set ARK_API_KEY env var (or MODEL_IMAGE_API_KEY / MODEL_AGENT_API_KEY) per SKILL.md prerequisites
_execution_protocol.step_2: Run `python3 tools/seedream_redraw_dryrun.py` to validate all 21 jobs against current filesystem (paths exist, sizes parse, prompts non-empty) — 0 errors required
_execution_protocol.step_3: Run `bash tools/seedream_redraw_runner.sh --tier 1` to execute Tier 1 (5 marketing-critical images) — sequential, model=5.0, watermark=false, output_format=png
_execution_protocol.step_4: Run `bash tools/seedream_redraw_runner.sh --tier 2` to execute Tier 2 (7 production tables)
_execution_protocol.step_5: Run `bash tools/seedream_redraw_runner.sh --tier 3` to execute Tier 3 (9 ingame assets)
_execution_protocol.step_6: After each tier: re-run Godot import (`godot --headless --import`) to regenerate .import + .uid sidecars
_execution_protocol.step_7: Update ASSET_REGISTRY.md — change model from 'built-in imagegen' to 'Seedream 5.0 (redrawn in #108+)' and bump Seed
_execution_protocol.step_8: Add an I020 smoke test that verifies (a) all 21 new PNGs have valid headers, (b) all .import files regenerate cleanly, (c) no legacy paths lost
_execution_protocol.step_9: Update CHANGELOG.md with redraw run summary (tier / model / wallclock / URL list)

_safety.rationale: Re-drawing always preserves the legacy PNG in a sibling _legacy/ folder (suffixed _legacy_<seed>) so we can diff or revert. Seedream 5.0 output is deterministic-ish given the same prompt + seed, but we never want to lose the original.
_safety.atomicity: Each tier is one git commit. If a tier fails partway, the runner skips remaining jobs in that tier and exits non-zero. The user can rerun the tier to continue.
_safety.rollback: To revert a redraw: `cp assets/<path>/_legacy/<file> <original-path> && godot --headless --import`. The legacy is always there.
